test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the errors in the given sentence and choose the sentence that rectifies these errors.

A youth must respect the elderly, the rich must help the needy and a powerful must help the weak. If we keep up this trend, then the world can be a beautiful place.

options.text: The youth must respect the elderly, the rich must help the needy and the powerful must help the weak. If we keep up this trend, then the world can be a beautiful place.
The youth must respect the elderly, rich must help needy and the powerful must help the weak. If we keep up this trend, then the world can be a beautiful place.
The youth must respect the elderly, the rich must help the needy and the powerful must help weak. If we keep up this trend, then the world can be a beautiful place.
The youth must respect the elderly, the rich must help the needy and powerful must help the weak. If we keep up this trend, then the world can be a beautiful place

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the inconsistency in the use of the definite article "the" before the nouns.
 
• In English, when referring to specific groups such as "the elderly," "the rich," and "the powerful," the definite article "the" should be used consistently.
 
• The correct sentence should use "the" before all these groups to ensure grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The youth must respect the elderly, the rich must help the needy and the powerful must help the weak. If we keep up this trend, then the world can be a beautiful place."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "The youth must respect the elderly, rich must help needy and the powerful must help the weak."** – This option omits "the" before "rich" and "needy," making it grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 3: "The youth must respect the elderly, the rich must help the needy and the powerful must help weak."** – This option omits "the" before "weak," making it grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 4: "The youth must respect the elderly, the rich must help the needy and powerful must help the weak."** – This option omits "the" before "powerful," making it grammatically incorrect.
